asr.full_text: Mirrored Trading International made easy! You may be thinking about joining Mti, or you may be a member already. Either way, here are some of the main points. Mirrored Trading International is a legally registered company in South Africa. The objective of Mirrored Trading International is to grow your Bitcoin. This is done by trading on the forex markets using Bitcoin as the base currency, using advanced proprietary software that MTI has exclusively obtained. The results speak for themselves, and over the last 100 days of trading, the daily profit for the investor has been 0.5834%. Please remember that historical data is not an indication of future results. You can add to your investment by depositing at any time. Likewise you can withdraw at any time. With a company like Mirror Trading International people often wonder where the greatest benefit is. The answer is simple. The greatest benefit you can get from MTI is by becoming a member or investor. You will receive daily trading results from trades which take place from Monday to Friday. Compounding is automatic. This means your daily profit is added to your Trading Pool and it becomes your new balance in trade. Sit back, relax and watch your Bitcoin grow. As the price of bitcoin goes up, so will your investment increases in value. Remember with historical results like these, your Bitcoin is growing! This is why we call MTI the Investors Game Changer! Join Mirror Trading International, today and experience all the benefits for yourself. The optional MTI Affiliate Program This is open to all members who have an investment in Mirra Trading International. The idea behind the affiliate program is to provide additional bonuses over and above your investment. You receive 10% referral bonuses on all new investments made by the people you introduce to MTI Binary Profit Sharing Bonuses 20% of the Daily Profits are shared between all qualified Members in accordance the size of their smallest team leg. To qualify for the weekly binary profit-sharing bonuses, You will need to have introduced at least two investors to the MTI business One in your left leg and one in your right leg In addition to this you will need to have a personal investment of at least $200 The affiliate program has been designed to help you earn additional weekly residual income but may require you to do a bit of extra work please remember the affiliate program is optional and it is is no way linked to the earning of your daily bonuses as an investor. For more information please contact the person who sent you this video.

textual.potential_relevance: A stated Bitcoin growth objective and historical daily profit percentage are linked to investment in a trading arrangement using Bitcoin as the base currency, requiring later assessment of the investment claim and caveat context.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish actual trading activity, realized returns, investor outcomes, regulatory status, or the accuracy of the historical profit claim.

visual.observation: Slides branded "Mirror Trading International" state an objective to "Grow your Bitcoin," describe proprietary trading software, and say the greatest benefit comes from becoming a "member/investor."
visual.context: The sampled visuals present these statements as promotional material for an entity identified on-screen as Mirror Trading International.
visual.potential_relevance: The stated Bitcoin-growth objective is linked to becoming a member/investor in the named organization.
visual.limitations: The frames do not show enrollment steps, an investment transfer, account terms, or any resulting return.

visual.observation: The video displays "100 days of Trading" and a "Daily Average 0.5834%," later saying that with historical results like these "your Bitcoin is growing"; another slide states that compounding is automatic and profit is added to the balance in trade.
visual.context: A visible qualification on the first performance slide says, "Historical Data is not an indication of Future Results."
visual.potential_relevance: A quantified historical daily trading average and automatic compounding description are presented in connection with the stated Bitcoin-growth investment offering.
visual.limitations: The frames do not establish that the percentage is guaranteed, how it was calculated, whether any viewer received it, or the terms governing balances and withdrawals.

visual.observation: A "Binary Profit Sharing Bonuses" slide says 20% of daily profits are shared among qualified members according to the size of their smallest team leg. A subsequent slide says weekly qualification requires introducing at least two investors, one in each leg, and having a personal investment of $200.
visual.context: The slides describe these as qualifications for weekly binary profit-sharing bonuses open to members with an investment in MTI.
visual.potential_relevance: The stated profit-sharing bonus is explicitly conditioned on both recruitment of two investors into a two-leg structure and a personal $200 investment.
visual.limitations: The frames do not show whether these conditions were enforced, whether payments occurred, or the full membership and bonus terms.

visual.observation: The final slide asks viewers seeking more information to contact the person who sent the video.
visual.context: The contact instruction appears alongside Mirror Trading International branding after the investment and bonus slides.
visual.potential_relevance: The video directs viewers to contact the sender in connection with the previously presented investment, return, and recruitment-related material.
visual.limitations: No contact details, communication content, or outcome of contacting the sender is visible.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes MTI as an investment to grow viewers’ Bitcoin, cites a 0.5834% daily profit figure, and solicits deposits along with referral and binary profit-sharing benefits requiring recruits and a personal investment. Although it includes a historical-results disclaimer and says the affiliate program is optional, it directs interested viewers to contact the sender about the investment and bonus program; the records do not establish actual trading, payments, or investor outcomes.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central offer is participation as an MTI member or investor, with Bitcoin deposited into a trading pool, daily trading results, and automatic compounding. The video also presents a separate affiliate structure in which introducing investors into left and right team legs qualifies members for profit-sharing bonuses, supporting S06 as a secondary mechanism.
